wish: someone should make a tool that hides data inside images
spec:
Hides a message or a small file in the lowest bits of an image's pixels, optionally locked with a password (AES-GCM), and saves it as a PNG that looks unchanged.
Pick an image (or use the sample), type the message, tap Hide, save; on the other side open the PNG under Reveal.
It does not survive recompression: JPEG re-saves, screenshots and chat apps that shrink photos erase the hidden data.

type.text: meet at the pier at six

expect.contains: meet at the pier at six

notes: Output is always PNG. Password mode uses PBKDF2 + AES-GCM via Web Crypto, offline.
